messages:
kevin: Quick live follow-up from today's All-Hands security section. We had a few product clarifications, starting this thread to capture Q&A.

maria: I'll jump in.

adriana: First Q: For SOC2 evidence requests from prospects, what's allowed to be shared pre-contract?

maria: We can share redacted SOC2 summary reports and architecture diagrams. Full evidence bundles and auditor reports require NDA and limited access via the auditor portal.

kevin: Second: Is 90-day audit log retention guaranteed in the SLA for enterprise customers?

maria: For Hosted enterprise tier we guarantee 90-day raw logs; Dedicated/Private customers can configure retention up to 365 days under contract. Longer retention has cost pass-through.

sasha: Legal reminder: any log exports to customer S3 require an ALA and a data processing addendum if logs include PII.

kevin: Is there a self-service checkbox in the console for "export logs to customer S3"?

maria: Not yet for hosted customers. Dedicated/Private: yes, there's a config option plus a Terraform module. For hosted we run an export job via support.

adriana: How do we show chain-of-custody for BYOK? Does Redwood ever have access to plaintext keys?

sasha: We don't hold plaintext BYOK keys unless escrow is enabled. Escrow is split-key with HSMs and requires dual-operator sign-off. We record all access in the audit logs and provide auditor access via portal.

kevin: Follow-up: rotation API? Webhook?

maria: We emit lifecycle webhooks (rotation.requested, rotation.completed) for Dedicated/Private; hosted customers get console notifications and support-assisted workflows.

audit-bot: Created SEC-9001 to add webhook schema examples to the docs, assigned to kevin. ETA: 1 week.

adriana: For ISO mapping progress?

maria: We're midway through control mapping; target submission for ISO certification in Q4. The mapping doc will be added to the evidence bundle folder.

kevin: Action: I'll add a short "security for PMs" checklist to the product templates repo and link it here.

sasha: I'll prepare a redacted ALA template for sales to hand to prospects.

kevin: Thanks. We'll close this after docs land.

maria: Uploading links when ready.
